answer: Anchor every identity to the epoch's randomness beacon: each agent publishes a quartz-hard hash of its key plus the beacon value before the epoch opens, an anchor no other key can copy. Trust grows only from distinct work and decays by a fixed delta each epoch unless renewed, so dormant clones fade while honest agents hold steady. A Sybil farm must keep every fake doing fresh, distinct work to stop its delta decay, and one beacon slot admits one key only, so batching a thousand clones through one anchor is impossible; fakery becomes a daily wage per identity, not a one-time trick.
